items.t: The Week Ahead: Your stories to look out for in North Central Florida
items.x: Follow all these stories and more here on TV20, our news app, and WCJB.com.

items.t: Ocala CEP highlights Horse-O-Ween
items.x: We’ll show you how some Ocala horse lovers are celebrating the season and getting kids involved in equine activities in the Weekly Buzz.

items.t: Eric Bauza, the modern voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and more, dies at 46
items.x: The actor lent his voice to such iconic Looney Tunes characters as Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Tweety, Elmer Fudd, Foghorn Leghorn, Porky Pig and more.

items.t: Horse Talk Show highlights Mounted Games at HITS Ocala
items.x: Top equestrians from across the globe came to Ocala to compete in the Mounted Games at HITS Ocala this past weekend.

items.t: Woman, 19, killed in West University Avenue crash
items.x: A 19-year-old woman was hit and killed along West University Avenue Saturday night, Gainesville police officials said.

items.t: Large fire at seafood processing plant prompts evacuations in Oregon city
items.x: A large fire at a seafood processing plant has prompted evacuations in an Oregon city over concerns that the smoke contained ammonia.

items.t: Mother dies trying to save her 2 sons after they were swept away while snorkeling
items.x: A British woman visiting the Bahamas with her family died rescuing her two sons after they were swept out to sea.

items.t: First Alert Weather Forecast: Pleasant Temps and Sunshine, But Gusty Winds for the Next Few Days
items.x: TV20 weather forecaster details the latest weather forecast for North Central Florida

items.t: No. 5 Florida volleyball sweeps Ole Miss to stay alone atop SEC
items.x: No. 5 Florida swept Ole Miss to stay alone in first in the SEC behind 13 kills from Kamryn Chaney and 11 from Alec Rothe.

items.t: High Springs candidate moves to end lawsuit over election qualifying process
items.x: Talks of a lawsuit involving a High Springs city commission candidate have halted.

items.t: Alachua County homebuyers explore Parade of new homes as property tax vote approaches
items.x: With home sales rising in the Gainesville area and a property tax amendment on the November ballot, potential homebuyers are getting a firsthand look at new housing options across Alachua County.

items.t: Not So Scary Triathlon draws kids to Albert Ray Massey Park
items.x: The Not So Scary Triathlon took place Sunday at Albert Ray Massey Park.

items.t: Zion Lutheran Church hosts first Oktoberfest in Gainesville
items.x: Zion Lutheran Church hosted its first Oktoberfest on Sunday.

items.t: Employee killed in workplace accident while in back of semitruck, troopers say
items.x: A man from Madill, Oklahoma, was killed in a workplace accident.

items.t: Alaska’s Democratic Senate candidate suffers minor injuries in car crash, campaign says
items.x: Alaska’s Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola and her family were injured in a car crash, delaying the last sprint of her campaign tour.

items.t: Palatka woman dies after being hit by two vehicles in Putnam County
items.x: A 38-year-old woman from Palatka is dead after being hit by two vehicles in Putnam County late last night.

items.t: Man dies after he was hit by 2 cars that fled the scene
items.x: A pedestrian died after he was injured in a double hit-and-run in Arizona Friday afternoon.

items.t: Alachua mobile home fire leaves 1 injured
items.x: One person is being treated for minor injuries after a mobile home fire in Alachua on Sunday afternoon.

items.t: Florida football moves up to No. 17 in AP Poll
items.x: The Gators football team had an off week, but still moved up to No. 17 in the AP Poll released Sunday afternoon.

items.t: Week Ahead in Washington: October 25
items.x: President Donald Trump continues his midterms travel, the Federal Reserve weighs interest rates, and the accused White House Correspondent's Dinner shooter is back in court. This is your Week Ahead in Washington for October 25.
